query: I gave birth a few days ago and keep becoming tearful for no clear reason.
Several weeks later I still feel empty and have stopped enjoying everything.
My thoughts race about whether I am doing everything wrong and I cannot calm down.
Every small task feels like too much and I cannot cope with being a new mother.
Even when the house is quiet I stay awake all night and have no energy.
I keep telling myself I am a terrible mother and that everything is my fault.
There is nobody I can talk to and I feel completely on my own.
My husband ignores me and we argue because he will not help at home.
I am grieving after my baby died and do not know how to carry this pain.
I feel distant from my newborn and worry that no connection is growing.
I lose my temper and shout over little things since the birth.
I struggle to wash, eat, focus, or make simple choices during the day.
How do I find a counsellor or nurse to discuss my emotional health?
I hear a voice that other people cannot hear and I am becoming confused.
Hashize iminsi mike mbyaye ariko ndarira kandi ibyiyumvo bigahindagurika.
Hashize ibyumweru byinshi numva nta byishimo mfite kandi nta cyizere.
Mpora mfite impungenge n'ubwoba kandi sinshobora gutuza.
Kuba umubyeyi mushya byarandenze kandi numva ntashoboye guhangana na byo.
Nabuze ibitotsi nijoro kandi ku manywa nta mbaraga mfite.
Ndigaya buri gihe nkumva ndi umubyeyi mubi kandi nta cyo maze.
Numva ndi jyenyine kuko nta nshuti cyangwa umuryango umfasha.
Umugabo wanjye aranyirengagiza kandi dufitanye amakimbirane kuko atamfasha.
Mfite agahinda kenshi nyuma yo gupfusha umwana wanjye.
Sinumva nkunze umwana kandi numva nitandukanyije na we.
Nyuma yo kubyara mpora ndakara kandi nkagira umujinya mwinshi.
Sinshobora kurya, kwiyuhagira cyangwa kwibanda ku mirimo ya buri munsi.
Nkeneye kuvugana n'umuforomo cyangwa umujyanama w'ubuzima ku byiyumvo byanjye.
Numva amajwi abandi batumva kandi mbona ibintu bitariho.
